source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original gate exposes the OAuth2 menu item when experimental.mail.ews.overrideOAuth.enabled is true and incoming.type is ews, without requiring a registered provider. Otherwise hostname/provider lookup still decides visibility. The accepted later method uses the Exchange predicate and also resets a disallowed OAuth selection; those are separate phases. Showing the option does not establish successful custom-provider authentication.
title: Unknown EWS providers gain an OAuth option only through the customization preference
